summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Inventory of seven diaspora instruments: Foreign Employment Saving Bond (NRB archive and PDMO debt statistics as primary records), NRN foreign-currency accounts, NRN direct investment under the NRN Act, NRN access to the government-securities secondary market (FY2082/83 budget), a diaspora/offshore NPR bond reported in the FY2083/84 budget, NRN quotas in equity issues, and knowledge/return programmes. No uptake values were recorded; uptake is pending retrieval of NRB issue results and PDMO outstanding-debt tables. NRN investment is not confirmed to be separately identified in NRB FDI surveys.

findings.claim: Q1: FESB issues since inception: issue size, amount subscribed, subscription rate, outstanding stock.
findings.note: Required: NRB FESB issue/allotment notices (23E-L01) and PDMO outstanding debt by instrument (23E-L03), Nepal FY.

findings.claim: Q1: NRN-attributed FDI (approved and realised) and NRN foreign-currency deposit stock.
findings.note: Required: NRB FDI survey tables if NRN category exists (23E-L06, 23E-L07); DoI approvals by NRN status; NRB deposit data by account type.

findings.claim: Q1: Status of diaspora bond / offshore NPR bond and NRN secondary-market access announced in FY2082/83 and FY2083/84 budgets.
findings.note: Required: official budget speech texts and any subsequent NRB/MoF implementing directive.

findings.claim: Q1: Academic/independent evidence on reasons for low diaspora-instrument uptake.
findings.note: Required: retrieval of 23E-L11 and peer-reviewed studies; barriers (awareness, purchase channels, relative returns) are hypotheses until retrieved.

findings.claim: Diaspora investment is distinguished from remittances for consumption: only flows into financial instruments or equity are counted as diaspora investment.

data_gaps: NRN-specific FDI and deposit data may not be published separately.
No primary documentation on diaspora bond design (FY2083/84) located beyond secondary budget highlights.
NRNA investment pledges vs realised investment: no audited source located.
SEBON NRN quota rules not yet located as a specific document.

assumptions.text: Instrument uptake is measured in NPR on a Nepal FY basis from NRB/PDMO records; USD conversions use NRB FY-average rates.

challenges.text: Exposure register could add a diaspora-capital entry (low uptake means low dependence but also unused financing capacity); proposal only.
Strategies relying on diaspora bonds as a financing source should be treated as UNVERIFIED until FESB historical uptake is retrieved.

uncertainty: High. Uptake of all instruments is unquantified in r1. Instrument status for FY2082/83-FY2083/84 budget announcements rests on secondary summaries; implementation is unverified.
